- `sp actions rollback` <proposal_id> --as <v> - Compensate an executed action (the L3 'act and notify' one-click rollback).

## Scenarios (`sp scenarios drop <name> [--process]`)
- `reference` - customers.xlsx (2 sheets -> customers + regions) and inventory .xls
- `history` - 4 clean days of sales (builds volume and distribution baselines)
- `baseline` - reference + history (run this first)
- `clean_day` - today's normal sales file
- `duplicate` - byte-identical re-delivery of today's file
- `schema_drift` - upstream renamed customer_id->client_code, amount->net_amount
- `additive_drift` - a new promo_code column appears
- `volume_drop` - truncated extract (18 rows instead of ~500)
- `volume_spike` - 5x rows (cumulative / duplicate delivery)
- `unit_change` - amounts sent in paise (x100)
- `stale_resend` - today's file contains 30-day-old orders
- `quality_failure` - 30% invalid channel / missing quantity
- `referential_break` - 40% of customer_ids do not exist
- `pii_leak` - card numbers typed into customers.notes
- `injection` - truncated file + a cell with a prompt injection
- `injection_filename` - instructions hidden in the file name
- `malformed` - binary garbage .csv and a fake .xlsx
- `encoding` - cp1252-encoded customers CSV
- `pipe_txt` - pipe-delimited inventory .txt
- `new_dataset` - unknown vendors_q3.csv
- `runbook_doc` - a free-text runbook
- `poisoned_doc` - a document with injected instructions
- `mass_failure` - 6 files with the same schema drift
- `freshness` - fast-forward the business clock 26h
- `oob_tamper` - modify the published sales table directly
- `crash` - crash the worker after 'transform' on the next file
- `llm_outage` - sim-large down + a volume drop
- `flaky_llm` - 25% timeouts + 30% malformed JSON + a unit change

## Agents
- `router` Router (hybrid, role=router) tools=[] - Classifies each arriving file (tabular / document / unsupported) and routes it to the right workflow.
- `privacy_guard` Privacy & Content Guard (deterministic, role=None) tools=[] - Deterministic PII detection/classification and prompt-injection scanning of file names and cells.
- `profiler` Profiler (hybrid, role=profiler) tools=[] - Statistical profiling plus LLM semantic typing against the business glossary.
- `steward` Contract Steward (hybrid, role=steward) tools=[] - Detects schema drift against the data contract, proposes rename mappings and new contracts (reviewed by the Critic).
- `critic` Critic (llm, role=critic) tools=[] - Independent evaluator (evaluator-optimizer pattern) for mappings, contract proposals and remediation plans.
- `transformer` Transformer (hybrid, role=transformer) tools=[] - Applies the contract (mapping, typing, rejects, dedupe); infers unknown date formats and VERIFIES them before use.
- `data_assurance` Data Assurance (deterministic, role=None) tools=[] - Runs contract checks (volume, schema, quality, freshness, drift, reconciliation, privacy) and trips the circuit breaker.
- `publisher` Publisher (deterministic, role=None) tools=[] - Masks PII per contract, stages immutable versions, publishes (blue/green) or quarantines.
- `correlator` Correlator (deterministic, role=None) tools=[] - Clusters related signals into one incident per probable cause (time window + lineage), before any model reasons.
- `supervisor` Triage Supervisor (llm, role=diagnoser) tools=[] - Plans the investigation, fans out to specialists, merges findings and owns the final grounded diagnosis.
- `investigator_intake` Intake Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_run_failure', 'search_knowledge'] - Read-only intake specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `investigator_schema` Schema Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_schema_diff', 'get_contract', 'recall_similar_incidents', 'search_knowledge'] - Read-only schema specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `investigator_volume` Volume Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_volume_history', 'get_check_results', 'search_knowledge', 'recall_similar_incidents'] - Read-only volume specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `investigator_quality` Quality Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_check_results', 'get_profile_comparison', 'get_sample_rows', 'search_knowledge', 'recall_similar_incidents'] - Read-only quality specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `investigator_freshness` Freshness Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_freshness_status', 'get_dataset_versions', 'search_knowledge'] - Read-only freshness specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `investigator_privacy` Privacy Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_check_results', 'get_contract', 'search_knowledge'] - Read-only privacy specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `investigator_security` Security Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_signal_details', 'search_knowledge'] - Read-only security specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `investigator_lineage` Lineage Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_lineage', 'get_open_incidents'] - Read-only lineage specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `investigator_integrity` Integrity Investigator (llm, role=investigator) tools=['get_version_integrity', 'get_dataset_versions'] - Read-only integrity specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.
- `impact` Impact Analyzer (deterministic, role=None) tools=[] - Walks lineage downstream to consumers, owners, SLAs and regulated outputs (blast radius).
- `planner` Remediation Planner (llm, role=planner) tools=[] - Proposes remediation strictly from the allowlisted action catalog; plans are critiqued before policy evaluation.
- `executor` Executor (deterministic, role=None) tools=['act_notify_owner', 'act_request_resend', 'act_quarantine_version', 'act_hold_downstream', 'act_release_hold', 'act_rollback_dataset', 'act_reprocess_with_mapping', 'act_update_contract', 'act_force_publish'] - The only agent holding write tools; executes approved/allowed catalog actions idempotently and records compensations.
- `verifier` Verifier (deterministic, role=None) tools=[] - Verifies every executed action against ground truth; runs the saga compensation when verification fails.
- `learner` Learner (llm, role=learner) tools=[] - Writes the blameless postmortem and proposes a lesson (episodic memory) and a regression eval case - humans curate both.
- `analyst` Analyst (llm, role=analyst) tools=['query_warehouse'] - Answers natural-language questions with read-only SQL over published datasets, through the semantic layer.
- `librarian` Librarian (llm, role=librarian) tools=[] - Summarizes and classifies ingested documents for the knowledge base (untrusted until a human promotes them).
- `judge` Judge (llm, role=judge) tools=[] - LLM-as-judge for explanation quality; must be calibrated against human labels before its scores are trusted.

## Tools
- `get_run_failure` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['run_id'] - Why a run failed: failed step, error, dead-letter entry and file metadata.
- `get_schema_diff` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['run_id'] - Schema diff of an ingest run against its data contract (missing/new columns, rename candidates, mapping proposal).
- `get_check_results` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['run_id'] - Data-assurance check results for an ingest run (failed, warnings, passed).
- `get_profile_comparison` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['run_id'] - Column statistics of a run's batch versus the last published baseline.
- `get_volume_history` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['dataset'] - Batch row counts of recent versions of a dataset versus the baseline median.
- `get_freshness_status` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['dataset'] - Declared freshness SLA of a dataset and whether it is overdue.
- `get_dataset_versions` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['dataset', 'limit'] - Recent immutable versions of a dataset with status and checksums.
- `get_contract` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['dataset'] - Active data contract of a dataset.
- `get_lineage` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['dataset', 'direction'] - Upstream or downstream lineage of a dataset (datasets and consumers).
- `get_open_incidents` v1.0 scope=incident:read read_only=True args=['dataset'] - Open incidents on datasets upstream of a dataset.
- `get_signal_details` v1.0 scope=incident:read read_only=True args=['incident_id'] - Signals attached to an incident, including raw details (UNTRUSTED content).
- `get_version_integrity` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['dataset'] - Compare the published table's current checksum with the one recorded at publish time.
- `search_knowledge` v1.0 scope=knowledge:read read_only=True args=['k', 'query'] - BM25 search over runbooks and documents; results carry trust labels and citations.
- `recall_similar_incidents` v1.0 scope=knowledge:read read_only=True args=['k', 'query'] - Recall human-approved lessons from past incidents (episodic memory).
- `get_sample_rows` v1.0 scope=data:read read_only=True args=['n', 'run_id'] - Sample of quarantined rows of a run (PII redacted, UNTRUSTED content).
- `query_warehouse` v1.0 scope=data:read:published read_only=True args=['sql'] - Run ONE read-only SQL SELECT over the tenant's published datasets (row-limited, authorizer-enforced).
- `act_notify_owner` v1.0 scope=action:notify_owner read_only=False args=['message', 'recipient', 'subject'] - Send the incident summary and evidence to an owner (email/chat outbox; URLs must be allowlisted).
- `act_request_resend` v1.0 scope=action:request_resend read_only=False args=['message', 'recipient'] - Ask the source owner to re-deliver a complete, current extract.
- `act_quarantine_version` v1.0 scope=action:quarantine_version read_only=False args=['version_id'] - Un-publish a published version; consumers fall back to the previous good version.
- `act_hold_downstream` v1.0 scope=action:hold_downstream read_only=False args=['datasets', 'reason'] - Pause rebuilds of derived datasets so bad data does not propagate.
- `act_release_hold` v1.0 scope=action:release_hold read_only=False args=['datasets', 'reason'] - Release held datasets so they rebuild.
- `act_rollback_dataset` v1.0 scope=action:rollback_dataset read_only=False args=['dataset', 'to_version_id'] - Re-point a dataset to an earlier version, or restore the current version from its immutable snapshot.
- `act_reprocess_with_mapping` v1.0 scope=action:reprocess_with_mapping read_only=False args=['dataset', 'file_id', 'mapping'] - Re-run a quarantined batch with a column rename mapping.
- `act_update_contract` v1.0 scope=action:update_contract read_only=False args=['add_columns', 'aliases', 'dataset'] - Create and activate a new contract version (add optional columns / aliases).
- `act_force_publish` v1.0 scope=action:force_publish read_only=False args=['justification', 'version_id'] - Publish a quarantined version despite failed checks (like 'set to OK'). Highest risk.

## Workflows
- `ingest_file`: stage -> route -> read -> fanout -> finalize - One file from the watched folder: stage, route, read, fan out per sheet, archive.
- `ingest_dataset`: load -> privacy -> profile -> onboard -> contract_check -> transform -> quality -> publish -> lineage - One dataset batch (a CSV or one sheet): privacy, profile, contract, transform, data assurance, publish/quarantine.
- `document`: read -> guard -> summarize -> index -> archive - Free-text document into the knowledge base (untrusted until promoted).
- `derive`: check -> build -> publish - Event-driven rebuild of a derived dataset, blocked when inputs are held or incident-bound.
- `triage`: open -> investigate -> diagnose -> impact -> plan -> govern -> execute -> await_approvals -> verify -> learn -> close - Incident triage swarm: investigate, diagnose, assess impact, plan, govern, act, verify, learn.

## MCP tools
- `pipeline_status` {'readOnlyHint': True, 'openWorldHint': False} - Queue depth, runs by status, open incidents, pending approvals, LLM cost.
- `list_incidents` {'readOnlyHint': True, 'openWorldHint': False} - Recent incidents with root cause and status.
- `get_incident` {'readOnlyHint': True, 'openWorldHint': False} - Diagnosis, signals, proposals and policy decisions for one incident.
- `list_datasets` {'readOnlyHint': True} - Published datasets, versions, holds and freshness.
- `get_lineage_impact` {'readOnlyHint': True} - Downstream datasets, consumers, owners and blast radius of a dataset.
- `search_knowledge` {'readOnlyHint': True} - BM25 search over runbooks and ingested documents (with trust labels).
- `ask_data_question` {'readOnlyHint': True, 'openWorldHint': False} - Natural-language question answered by the Analyst agent with read-only SQL over published data.
- `list_pending_approvals` {'readOnlyHint': True} - Agent actions waiting for a human decision.
- `decide_approval` {'readOnlyHint': False, 'destructiveHint': True, 'idempotentHint': False, 'openWorldHint': False} - Approve or reject a pending agent action. High-risk actions need confirm_text = the dataset name and a comment.
- `drop_scenario` {'readOnlyHint': False, 'destructiveHint': False, 'idempotentHint': False, 'openWorldHint': False} - Write synthetic files for a named scenario into the watched folder (e.g. volume_drop, schema_drift).
- `get_evidence_pack` {'readOnlyHint': True} - The audit-grade evidence pack of an incident.

## Prompts
- `analyst_sql` v1 (role analyst) - Natural language to read-only SQL over governed, published datasets.
- `critic` v1 (role critic) - Evaluator in an evaluator-optimizer loop; critiques mappings, contracts and remediation plans.
- `date_format` v1 (role transformer) - Infer the strptime format of date values that failed to parse with the contract formats.
- `diagnoser` v1 (role diagnoser) - Supervisor that merges specialist findings into one grounded root-cause diagnosis.
- `diagnoser` v2 (role diagnoser) - Candidate diagnoser prompt (stricter grounding); runs in shadow mode for comparison.
- `investigator` v1 (role investigator) - Read-only specialist investigator (ReAct tool loop) in the incident triage swarm.
- `judge` v1 (role judge) - LLM-as-judge for diagnosis explanations (v1 rubric; known to be biased toward long answers).
- `judge` v2 (role judge) - LLM-as-judge v2 rubric with explicit anti-verbosity instructions (calibrated against human labels).
- `judge_pairwise` v1 (role judge) - Pairwise preference judge (used to measure position bias by swapping A/B).
- `learner` v1 (role learner) - Blameless postmortem + candidate lesson + candidate eval case from a closed incident.
- `librarian` v1 (role librarian) - Summarize and classify an ingested text document for the knowledge base.
- `planner` v1 (role planner) - Remediation planner; may only propose actions from the allowlisted action catalog.
- `profiler` v1 (role profiler) - Map physical columns to semantic types and business glossary terms.
- `router` v1 (role router) - Classify an arriving file as tabular data, a free-text document, or unsupported.
- `steward_contract` v1 (role steward) - Propose an initial data contract for a new, unknown dataset (onboarding).
- `steward_mapping` v1 (role steward) - Propose source->contract column mappings for a schema drift (renamed columns).
